text: I keep clicking on this face here and it edits the roof ???? [Image #1]
resolution: Corrected the initial hit-test diagnosis after the user showed the visual selection was lighting the correct face. The real issue was stale material-target state: clicking a wall selected/highlighted it, but the material browser could still be pointed at an older roof target. The fix is covered by the follow-up change that ties stage face selection to the active material target.
